seo.title: Stretch Easy — Guided Stretching Routines for iOS
seo.description: Simple guided stretching routines with timers. Pre-built or custom routines, haptic cues, Apple Watch support. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: GUIDED MOBILITY
hero.title: Guided stretching routines.
text: Simple stretch routines with visual timers and haptic cues. Pre-built or custom — pick one and follow along.

items.title: Pre-Built Routines
items.text: Morning Wake-Up, Desk Break, Post-Workout, Full Body, Evening Wind-Down — ready to go in seconds.

items.title: Custom Routine Builder
items.text: Build your own routines from 15+ stretches. Set custom durations and save them for next time.

items.title: Visual Timers
items.text: Large countdown display with clear stretch names. See your progress through the routine at a glance.

items.title: Haptic Feedback
items.text: Subtle haptic cues guide you through transitions. Know when to switch without watching the screen.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Full routine support on your wrist. Haptic guidance per stretch — use independently or with your iPhone.

items.title: HealthKit Sync
items.text: Automatically log flexibility workouts to Apple Health. Track your stretching habit over time.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your data stays yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No accounts. No cloud sync. Everything stays on your device. HealthKit logging is optional.

cta.title: Start stretching.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
